method.title: Assembly votes
method.intro: The page "The Assembly's votes" reproduces, without summarising or rewriting the official titles, the public ballots of the 17th legislature published as open data by the Assemblée nationale. Only the category names and the result sentences are written by Polithèque.
method.criteriaLead: The list follows a fixed rule, applied by a program to every public ballot, with no manual exception. A vote is included when it falls under one of these cases:
method.R1: R1: vote on the whole of a government or private member's bill, or on a resolution, however the title is worded
method.R2: R2: vote on the single article of such a text (single-article text)
method.R3: R3: motion of no confidence (article 49, paragraphs 2 and 3)
method.R4: R4: confidence vote on a general policy statement (article 49, paragraph 1) or vote on a Government statement (article 50-1)
method.source: The data comes from the "Scrutins" and "Acteurs, mandats et organes" files of the Assemblée nationale's open data (data.assemblee-nationale.fr). It is published under the Licence Ouverte / Open Licence (Etalab): the source is cited on every page, with the extraction date. Each vote page links to the Assembly's official page.
method.limitHand: Show of hands: only votes by public ballot are recorded by name. A text adopted by show of hands does not appear.
method.limitSchema: Diagram: seats are arranged by official seat number; this is not the exact plan of the chamber, which the Assembly does not publish as coordinates.
method.limitCensure: Motions of no confidence: the Assembly records only the votes in favour; other members did not vote the motion, which is not a vote against.
method.limitDelegation: Proxies: a member may vote on behalf of a colleague; the page says so without interpreting it.
method.limitPoint: Voting corrections: a member may publish afterwards that they wished to vote otherwise. It is shown as such, and changes neither the result nor the counts.
method.limitGroups: Groups: a parliamentary group is not a party. The group shown is the one on the day of the vote.
method.neutrality: No attendance, loyalty or cohesion rate, no ranking, no score: the page shows votes, not a judgement on members or groups.
method.criteriaExcluded: Votes on amendments and on single articles, rejected rejection motions and other procedural motions are not included.
method.limit493: Article 49, paragraph 3: a text adopted under this procedure is not voted on (it is deemed adopted unless a motion of no confidence is adopted); only the motions of no confidence filed in response appear. This note is repeated on paragraph 3 motions and on votes on a part of a finance bill.
method.limitNonVoters: Non-voters: when the source gives the cause (chair of the sitting, member of the Government), it is shown in the table of members.
method.R5: R5: preliminary rejection motion adopted (it rejects the whole text)
method.R6: R6: vote on a part (first, second or third) of a finance bill or social security financing bill

notes.article493: When the Government makes the passing of a text a matter of its responsibility (article 49, paragraph 3), the text is deemed adopted without a vote, unless a motion of no confidence is adopted. There is therefore no final vote on that text: only the motions of no confidence filed in response appear here.
notes.article493Source: Constitution of 4 October 1958, article 49 (text in force)
notes.budgetMotions: Motions of no confidence filed on this text (article 49, paragraph 3)
